name: ACS student membership
summary: A discounted membership of Australia's main tech professional body for full-time students.
key: $72 a year for full-time students living in Australia.
numbers: Networking events, a digital library, courses and certifications, and the ACS career platform
how: Apply through Join or Get Certified on the ACS site.
catches: ACS's page doesn't spell out who counts as a full-time student. Ask Member Services on +61 2 9299 3666.
